blurb: Welcome to Fishermans Cove Resort, your premier destination for an unforgettable family vacation in Republic WA. Nestled on the shores of Curlew Lake, our resort is the perfect blend of nostalgic charm and modern comfort. We offer 16 cabin rentals and 8 lake front R.V spots. Rental boats, kayaks, and paddle boards are available to rent on site.
